title: Simin Zetwal
synopsis: In a working-class city of Mauritius, old Bolom has disappeared. His son Ronaldo sets out to find him and crosses paths with Ajeya, an Indian immigrant worker. He dreams of a golden boy's life, she flees her condition of modern slave. Together, their nocturnal crossing of the island takes on a new dimension, between a mystical journey and a desire for freedom.
awards: Best Editing - Carthage Film Festival
Special Mention - FESPACO
FIPRESCI Prize & Bronze Award - Luxor African Film Festival

title: Smaragda – I Got Thick Skin And I Can't Jump
synopsis: The film follows Smaragda, a middle-aged woman on a journey of self-discovery. After countless failed relationships and a stagnant career, she decided to jump into social media for some notion of visibility, which she definitely sucks at.
awards: Best Cypriot Film & Best Performance - Cyprus Film Days International Festival
Special Jury Award for Performance - LA Greek Film Festival

title: Al Djanat, The Original Paradise
synopsis: The death of a Burkinabé family's patriarch and the division of his estate unearths conflict between his heirs and larger questions about inheritance, belonging and the communal customs of West Africa versus Westernized courts.
awards: Best African Documentary - Al Jazeera-Encounters Award

title: Hidden People
synopsis: Guti and Sig wake up naked and handcuffed to one another on a riverbank near Ljubljana. Sig suffers from memory loss, after a fight with skinheads that Guti tried peacefully to intervene. Sig has no passport or any clue about his identity, the skinheads have taken everything he owned. Guti is trying to build a new home for himself and introduces Sig to his friends, a group of suburban misfits, who remind Sig of a legend of the hidden people.

title: Maria's Silence
synopsis: In 1937, silent film star Maria Leiko travels to USSR upon learning of the birth of her granddaughter. But when she discovers the tragic circumstances of that event, KGB agents persuade her to remain in the country. Leiko abandons her cinema career to instead join Skatuve, the Latvian State Theatre in Moscow. Soon she discovers that she is being manipulated by the government amid its purges of political enemies.
awards: Prize of the Ecumenical Jury - Berlinale
Best Feature Film - Lielais Kristaps Awards (Latvia)
Best Director - Lielais Kristaps Awards (Latvia)

title: Greice
synopsis: Greice, a Brazilian girl studying in Lisbon, gets involved with a mysterious guy and ends up getting accused of a strange incident that occurs at the students' welcoming party, which forces her to return to her hometown to renew her residence permit. Hidden in a hotel, while preventing her mother from discovering she's back in the country and with the help of some friends, Greice tries to find a place of comfort in the world.
awards: Best Director - IndieLisboa International Independent Film Festival
Best Screenplay - IndieLisboa International Independent Film Festival
Best Performance - Olhar de Cinema (Brazil)

title: Loss Of Balance
synopsis: Even though Maja has devoted her entire life to acting, she does not believe in herself and her abilities. Therefore, after graduating from acting, she plans to apply for marketing and management. Everything changes when a new director crosses Maja's path.
awards: Best Screenplay - Shanghai International Film Festival
Multiple awards (4 wins) - Polish Film Festival in Gdynia

title: Tits
synopsis: After an argument, best friends Jasmine and Iben loose the sight of each other at the beach. Jasmine meets up with the girls. Iben hooks up with Jonas, the boy she is crazy about. Later on, the seemingly shy boy Oscar has an unpleasant run in with Iben. When both of them are left behind by their friends, one of them makes a friendly gesture and they soon realise that they are dealing with similar issues.

title: Life & Love
synopsis: 1930s aspiring writer moves to the city and works as a maid for a printing house owner. Their whirlwind romance leads to marriage, but their relationship darkens against the backdrop of growing social unrest.
awards: Best Baltic Film - Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival

title: Taamaden
country: Belgium, Cameroon, France, Mali, South Africa
synopsis: Bakary, a young man from Mali, sits on a rock in a lake and pours a small packet of milk over his head and body. He then takes an egg, looks at it carefully and says “Monday”, after which he breaks it and drops the yolk into the water. He repeats this several times. Having followed all his marabout's instructions to the letter, his next crossing should now be successful.
awards: Best Documentary - Africa Movie Academy Awards

title: Breathing Underwater
synopsis: When Emma has to leave her picture-perfect life for a women's shelter, her unlikely friendship with a ragtag group of women pushes them all into a fight to take back their power.
awards: Special Jury Prize - Lecce European Film Festival
Cineuropa Award - Lecce European Film Festival

title: Monsieur Aznavour
synopsis: From his poor childhood to his rise to fame, from his triumphs to his failures, from Paris to New York, discover the exceptional journey of an artist. Intimate, intense, fragile and indestructible, devoted to his art until the very end, here is one of the most immortal singers of all time: MONSIEUR AZNAVOUR.
awards: Best Costume Design - César Awards

title: The Painter And The Thief
synopsis: When two of artist Barbora Kysilkova's most valuable paintings are stolen from a gallery at Frogner in Oslo, the police are able to find the thief after a few days, but the paintings are nowhere to be found. Barbora goes to the trial in hopes of finding clues, but instead she ends up asking the thief if she can paint a portrait of him.
awards: Best Film - Amanda Awards
Special Jury Award for Creative Storytelling - Sundance Film Festival
Best Documentary - BFI London Film Festival

title: Nha Fala
synopsis: One fateful summer, a group of elementary school kids set adrift on an abandoned apartment building must look within themselves to find a way back home.
awards: City of Rome Prize - Venice Film Festival
City of Amiens Prize - Amiens International Film Festival
Intercultural Communication Prize - Views of Africa Festival

title: Mr. Nobody Against Putin
synopsis: As Russia launches its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, primary schools across Russia's hinterlands are transformed into recruitment stages for the war. Facing the ethical dilemma of working in a system defined by propaganda and violence, a brave teacher goes undercover to film what's really happening in his own school.
dropdownLabel: Mr. Nobody Against Putin – Saturday 26 Sep, 14:00
awards: Best Documentary Feature - Academy Awards
Best Documentary - BAFTA
Peabody Award - Peabody Awards

title: Jokes & Cigarettes
synopsis: Barcelona, Spain, in the late sixties. Eugenio, a young jeweler who has fallen in love with Conchita, a singer, to the point of learning to play the guitar to accompany her in her performances, will first have to learn to overcome his stage fright.
awards: Best Actor - Goya Awards
Best Actress - Gaudí Awards
Best Actor - Feroz Awards

title: A New Kind Of Wilderness
synopsis: In a forest in Norway, a family lives an isolated lifestyle in an attempt to be wild and free, but a tragic event changes everything, and they are forced to adjust to modern society.
awards: World Cinema Grand Jury Prize: Documentary - Sundance Film Festival
Best Documentary - Golden Panda Awards

title: Seven Days
synopsis: The imprisoned Iranian women's rights activist Maryam is allowed to meet her family for seven days. Her husband and children beg Maryam to flee with them instead of returning to prison but she has not yet made her decision.
awards: 3rd Prize - Farhang Foundation Short Film Festival

title: Songs Of Earth
synopsis: With Olin's 85-year-old father as guide, we experience Norway's most adventurous valley, Oldedalen in Nordfjord. He grew up here, and here generations before him have lived in balance with nature.
awards: Best Original Score (Documentary) - International Film Music Critics Association (ISFMF)

title: Rafiki
country: Germany, Netherlands, France, Norway, USA, South Africa, Belgium
synopsis: Kena and Ziki long for something more. Despite the political rivalry between their families, the girls resist and remain close friends, supporting each other to pursue their dreams in a conservative society. When love blossoms between them, the two girls will be forced to choose between happiness and safety.
awards: Best Actress - FESPACO
Audience Award - Sydney Film Festival
Grand Jury Award - Milan International LGBT Film Festival
Silver Hugo - Chicago International Film Festival

title: Ninjababy
synopsis: When Rakel finds out she's six months pregnant after a one-night stand, her world changes. She is absolutely not ready to be a mother, but since abortion is no longer an option, adoption is the only answer. That's when Ninjababy, an animated character who makes Rakel's life a living hell, turns up.
awards: European Comedy Award - European Film Awards
Audience Award - SXSW
Crystal Bear - Special Mention - Berlinale
Best Director - Amanda Awards
Best Actress - Amanda Awards

title: Banel & Adama
synopsis: Chaos ensues shortly after a young man in a remote village in northern Senegal refuses to accept his role as the new village chief.
awards: Bright Horizons Award - Melbourne International Film Festival
Best Directing Prize - Marrakech Film Festival

title: Peacock
synopsis: Matthias is a master of pretense, from cultured boyfriend to perfect son or marital coach. He makes a career of being someone else. The real challenge begins when he has to be himself.
awards: Best First Feature Award - Stockholm International Film Festival
Best Leading Actor - Austrian Film Awards

title: A Boat In The Garden
synopsis: I can tell you about my father's voyage on his boat, because I was with him all the time. It was a rather strange voyage, with no ocean or sea crossing, not even a lock to pass through... The boat stayed at home and so did my father. But that does not mean there was no adventure...
dropdownLabel: A Boat In The Garden – Friday 18 Sep, 18:00
awards: Special Distinction Prize - Bucheon International Animation Festival
Best Animated Feature Film - Cartoons On The Bay - Pulcinella Award

title: Waves
synopsis: At Kichijōji Station, Tokyo, Taku Morisaki glimpses a familiar woman on the platform opposite boarding a train. Later, her photo falls from a shelf as he exits his apartment before flying to Kōchi Prefecture. Picking it up, he looks at it briefly before leaving. As the aeroplane takes off, he narrates the events that brought her into his life...
awards: Best Feature Film - Czech Lion Awards
Best Director - Czech Lion Awards
Best Screenplay - Czech Lion Awards
Audience Award - Karlovy Vary International Film Festival

title: A Happy Day
synopsis: Three teenage friends stuck in a frozen, hopeless place come up with a plan to escape over the mountain to a world where their dreams can be fulfilled. But when one of them falls in love, their plan begins to unravel.
awards: Best Director - Duhok International Film Festival
Best Cinematography - Duhok International Film Festival
FIPRESCI Prize - Duhok International Film Festival

title: Maybe Elephants
synopsis: Three rebellious teenage daughters, a restless mother, a father struggling with potatoes, and maybe some elephants, find themselves in Nairobi. What could possibly go wrong?
awards: Audience Prize - Bucheon International Animation Festival
Best Nordic-Baltic Animated Youth Film - Fredrikstad Animation Festival
Best Animated Short - Canadian Screen Award

title: Jippie No More
synopsis: Jaap Peter, a lively 16 year old boy, eagerly prepares for his older sister's wedding at their beloved grandfather's country house. As the whole family rallies together to create the perfect celebration, Jaap Peter falls in love for the first time. But when the girl of his dreams is smitten with his younger sister instead, Jaap Peter is disheartened. Through the chaos and tender moments, Jaap Peter learns that his presence and the unbreakable bond of his family are vital in ensuring the wedding's success.
awards: Audience Award - Cinekid Festival
Youth Jury Award - Cinekid Festival

title: Living Large
synopsis: A 12-year-old boy faces bullying due to his weight and decides to take charge of his life by adopting a healthier lifestyle and trying to win the heart of the girl he admires. Through his journey, he learns the importance of positivity and standing against body shaming, discovering that true confidence comes from embracing who you are.
awards: Best Feature Award - European Children's Film Association (ECFA)
Jury Award - Annecy International Animation Film Festival

title: Pearl Diver
synopsis: This is a film about three couples that are drifting apart. A hedgehog falls in love with a balloon, but struggles to keep up his grooming routine. There is a coldness between an arctic/antarctic couple, and two naive oysters are longing to meet.
awards: International Grand Jury Prize - Animayo Gran Canaria Festival

title: The Mohican
synopsis: Joseph is one of the last coastal shepherds in Corsica. His land is coveted by the underworld for a real estate project but he chooses not to give in. When he leaves the man who came to intimidate him, the godfather's own son, between life and death, he becomes the prey of a merciless hunt.

title: Nuit Chérie (Sweet Night)
synopsis: During the Himalayan winter, a bear cannot fall asleep. He thinks too much and is in the doldrums. When a white monkey suggests him go to eat some honey at his aunt to change his ideas, a beautiful winter night opens upon them.

title: Campeones (Champions)
synopsis: A disgraced basketball coach is sentenced to community service coaching a team of players with intellectual disabilities. Through his journey, he learns about teamwork, compassion, and the true meaning of winning.

title: Tarrac
synopsis: Aoife Ní Bhraoin returns to her home on the Dingle Peninsula in the Kerry Gaeltacht to help her father, Breandán 'The Bear' Ó Braoin, recover from a heart attack. As they navigate their strained relationship, Aoife confronts the grief of her mother's death and finds purpose training with a local rowing crew for a prestigious naomhóg race.
